summary: Defines an extension object that can be appended to certain ICMP messages so that Label Switching Routers can include MPLS information in them. This helps people diagnosing paths through MPLS networks see label details. The memo notes the extension was already widely deployed. It is on the standards track.

eli5.summary: When a mail carrier sends back a note saying a package got stuck, this lets the note also say which special sorting lane the package was in.

questions: how do routers report mpls labels in icmp
